publicationDateRule: Set immediately before the sole combined push to the UTC date on which the routes are expected to become public, then verify that same date after deployment.

articles.title: Allocate one supplier invoice across split shipment receipts
articles.readerOutcome: Reconcile one billed quantity to several receipts, reversals, locations, and open balances without manufacturing a match.

articles.title: Resolve a supplier portal invoice status that conflicts with the AP ledger
articles.readerOutcome: Trace portal status, ERP documents, credits, payments, and synchronization timing before answering the supplier or changing a record.

articles.title: Review the effective date of a vendor payment-terms change
articles.readerOutcome: Separate master-data maintenance from commercial approval and determine which invoices a newly approved term should affect.

articles.title: Resolve an invoice hold after a service-entry sheet is rejected
articles.readerOutcome: Reconstruct the service period, entry sheet, rejection reason, contract line, invoice, and correction owner without creating acceptance evidence.

articles.title: Prepare invoice withholding-tax evidence for specialist review
articles.readerOutcome: Assemble supplier, jurisdiction, document, calculation, and approval evidence while reserving tax conclusions for the authorized specialist.

articles.title: Investigate a supplier legal-name mismatch on an invoice
articles.readerOutcome: Distinguish a trading name, entity change, branch, typo, or wrong supplier account before coding or changing vendor master data.

articles.title: Build a support packet for a supplier credit-balance refund request
articles.readerOutcome: Prove the credit origin, ownership, open-item history, bank-safe contact path, and approval needed before requesting cash back.

articles.title: Find the right owner for a subscription renewal invoice
articles.readerOutcome: Use contract, requester, access, renewal, and cancellation evidence to route a recurring charge without inventing approval.

articles.title: Review a utility invoice with a site or account-number mismatch
articles.readerOutcome: Tie the bill to a meter, service address, billing period, legal entity, and verified provider account before processing.

articles.title: Screen for duplicate invoices after an ERP migration
articles.readerOutcome: Compare legacy and new-system identifiers, normalized invoice fields, conversion records, and payment history without collapsing legitimate splits.

articles.title: Reconcile a corporate-card central bill to employee transactions
articles.readerOutcome: Bridge the issuer total to cardholder charges, credits, fees, disputes, and missing reports while keeping payment release separate.

articles.title: Reroute invoice approval after a cost-center reorganization
articles.readerOutcome: Preserve the original approval trail, effective-dated ownership, coding questions, and escalation clock when responsibility moves.
